facts.statement: SOE and Child's Play ran a charity drive in Free Realms in which purchases of Child's Play items led SOE to donate money to Child's Play.
facts.quote: Wenn ihr einen "Child's Play"-Gegenstand kauft, wird Sony Online Entertainment für jeden erworbenen Gegenstand $10 (bis zu $50 000) spenden.

article_summaries.title: "SOE Child's Play"-Spendenaktion
article_summaries.summary: A SOE news post (German text on a Portuguese-language page wrapper) announcing the yearly SOE x Child's Play charity drive in Free Realms. Players buy Child's Play items, mainly the Snowflake unicorn mount, during December, and SOE donates $10 per item up to $50,000. The page gives a relative age ('10 months, 3 weeks ago') rather than an exact date.
